_comment: Performance regression baselines (issue #3510). Times are median per-call seconds, captured on a self-hosted dev runner with Python 3.11.15. Tests in test_regression_benchmarks.py compare measured medians against these values multiplied by tests.benchmarks.regression_helpers.DEFAULT_REGRESSION_MULTIPLIER (5x). Update this file when an intentional perf-affecting change is made; document the rationale in the commit.
